snippet.title: Castlevania: Belmont‘s Curse Gameplay & Commentary Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Crimson Curse —Will Your Fate Bloom in Despair or Salvation

Discover a new trailer for Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse with  all-new gameplay and commentary highlighting a blend of action and exploration, while further exploring the game setting—1499 Paris.

Follow a young Belmont's jouney in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin, to be released in 2026.

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!
